chunks: Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The best of your women is the one who, if she becomes angry or causes her husband to become angry, says to her husband: 'My hand is in your hand; I will not sleep until you are pleased with me.'

key_terms.أَغْضَبَتْ: she caused anger in another, here her husband
key_terms.لَا أَكْتَحِلُ بِغُمْضٍ: I will not sleep or rest
key_terms.يَدِي فِي يَدِكَ: an expression of yielding and reconciliation

ai.seo_question: What qualities does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام praise in the best of women?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a praiseworthy trait in a wife: seeking reconciliation quickly after marital anger or conflict. It praises humility, emotional restraint, and eagerness to restore harmony within the family.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4366 - Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) who said:
"The best of your women is the one who, if she becomes angry or causes her husband to become angry, says to him, 'My hand is in your hand, and I will not rest until you are pleased with me.'"
